1479-2841-8104-8337.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
1479-2841-8104-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1778-5006-5147-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Memnite is starting in your graveyard.
1778-5006-5147-8170.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Memnite, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

4613-5475-6218.easyPrerequisites:
Pheres-Band Tromper doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Forensic Researcher is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4613-5475-6218.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5475-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5170-5332-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

620-1429-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1011-2728-3967-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-3967-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-3967-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4.

618-2921-4681.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3257-5256-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4865-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4865-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Dack's Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4865-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1479-2841-6159-7705.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6159-7705.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

751-7426-7427.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Three Tree Scribe triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

907-1558-3129-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-3129-3875-4231.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1409-3129-5418.description:
Activate Exhibition Magician by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Exhibition Magician enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Exhibition Magician.
Resolve the Exhibition Magician trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5330-6972-7156.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1661-2033-3713-5078.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

3557-3908-7009.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago. Brago triggers, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1170-1329-3518-6965.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

1399-1606-2957-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
1399-1606-2957-6071.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos

333-2730-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

292-4772-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-4772-4968.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

2438-4681-4730-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

413-719-1789-5649.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
413-719-1789-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Blasting Station trigger.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing's Thrall trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

457-5159-5223-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-5159-5223-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

654-1170-2499-3389-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-2692-3143-5696.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-2692-3143-5696.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2438-4275-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
2438-4275-5470.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token created in step 2.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2981-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2981-5490.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1344-1636-4481.notablePrerequisites:
Heavy Arbalest attached to Nested Ghoul.
Nested Ghoul does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Nested Ghoul indestructible.
1344-1636-4481.description:
Give Nested Ghoul indestructible, if needed.
Activate Nested Ghoul by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to itself.
Nested Ghoul triggers, creating a 2/2 Phyrexian Zombie creature token.
When the Phyrexian Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

352-4539-5184-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
352-4539-5184-5195.description:
Cast Unexpected Windfall by paying {2}{R}{R} and discarding a card.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Unexpected Windfall.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the copy of Unexpected Windfall, creating three Treasure artifact tokens and causing you to draw two cards.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

2342-2512-2603.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Shaman en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Shaman en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

1992-2646-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1992-2646-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, Basri's Lieutenant's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

985-3581-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat

57-366-1402-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
57-366-1402-2178.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Purphoros triggers, dealing 2 damage to each of your opponent.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Feldon of the Third Path.
Repeat.

1116-2511-3240-4289.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token creature with haste.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Graveborn token using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Graveborn token.
Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Nether Traitor using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
